name: Lending Rates API
shortDescription: Compare DeFi lending rates across Aave, Compound, Spark, and Morpho — find the best yield with risk context
description: Compare DeFi lending rates across Aave, Compound, Spark, Morpho, Euler, and other major protocols. Get current APY, 7-day and 30-day averages, utilization rates, and rate trends. Compare risk-adjusted yields side-by-side with protocol audit status, insurance availability, and withdrawal delays. Get a full ONE-CALL intelligence package with the best rate, trend analysis, protocol risk, and deposit recommendation. Built for yield optimization agents, DeFi portfolio managers, and treasury automation.
